mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a cool 68 degrees with overcast skies near Verona City Hall under a New Moon.

The City has announced road construction on Highway M beginning August 18, which will shift traffic patterns and include utility work. Additionally, the Senior Center is looking for volunteers to commit to two shifts a month.

We have plenty to look forward to! Today, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard. Tomorrow, enjoy the Dane County Farmers Market or music at Paddy Mac's, and head out on August 16 for the Cave Carnival at Cave of the Mounds.
The Verona Police Department reported that on Wednesday, August 5, officers apprehended a 37-year-old man on Whalen Road following a probation violation warrant.
Today's delicious flavor is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The store is currently closed but will open its doors at 10:00 AM. Tomorrow, you can look forward to the Turtle flavor.
